name: motion-showreel
description: Make stunning 5-60s short videos entirely in code: showreels, product teasers, UI morphs, kinetic typography, logo stings, generative loops. Deterministic render(t) pages rendered frame by frame with Playwright + ffmpeg, optional code-synthesized music and SFX sharing one timeline with the picture, a one-checkpoint workflow and programmatic technical acceptance kept separate from human review.
